verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is the cluster-wide scan command `trivy k8s --report summary cluster`, which scans a whole Kubernetes cluster in one invocation. Filesystem scanning across multiple lock files is a weaker form of the same thing. Missing for 10: documented batch or multi-target scanning of many images or repos in one operation, any description of how many items a bulk run covers or what it reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Trivy will look for vulnerabilities based on lock files such as Gemfile.lock and package-lock.json.
